Network Technology Case Studies Fact Sheets and Guides Reports Glossary Trackers and Dashboards Webinars Start Here Digital Opportunity Lab Start a Community Network Sign Up For a Network Educate Your Local Community Subscribe Donate Tribal Broadband Bootcamps in Action - Episode 641 of the Community Broadband Bits Podcast By Jordan Pittman on Apr 1, 2025 In this episode of the podcast, Chris sit down again with Matt Rantanen to discuss the transformative impact of the Tribal Broadband Bootcamps. Rantanen shares insights on the evolution of these hands-on training sessions, which empower tribal communities with the technical skills and policy knowledge needed to build and sustain broadband networks. We explore the challenges tribes face in accessing high-quality Internet, the role of community-driven solutions, and what’s next for broadband expansion in Indian Country. Tune in to learn how these bootcamps are equipping Indigenous leaders with the tools to close the digital divide. This show is 37 minutes long and can be played on this page or via Apple Podcasts or the tool of your choice using this feed . Transcript below.
